g.text: Sunshine hours depend on daylight length as well as cloud (0 oktas = clear, 8 = overcast). Rain: Perth Metro; other panels: Perth Airport.
Pan evaporation indicates atmospheric drying conditions; this cross-station comparison is not a soil-water balance.
